ownership: All keyword criteria are agent-owned test observations from this independently frozen arm. They are separate from requester definitions and pack-derived strict gates.

all_of: One unobstructed human face is visible.
Visible face shape and eye/nose/mouth relations are recognizably consistent with the supplied reference guidance; this is visual resemblance, not identity proof.
keyword_gates.source_phrase: Use the supplied image as visible facial appearance guidance

all_of: A pale ivory cloth is visibly wrapped across both shoulders.
The wrap has separate textile edges and folds over the navy dress.

all_of: Two overlapping cloth edges meet at the upper chest.
One small round silver clasp visibly fastens those same fabric edges, rather than attaching to bare skin or unrelated necklace.

all_of: A rectangular brass buckle is on one black leather waist belt.

all_of: One rigid geometric brass cuff encircles the subject left upper arm.

all_of: The subject right elbow/wrist/hand form a connected chain.

keyword_gates.source_phrase: her right thumb and forefinger rest on the loose belt tail beside the closed buckle

strict_pack_gates.criterion: Important body parts visibly belong to the intended adult human actor; jewelry, fabric and belt remain separate carriers.
Both connected arms articulate plausibly; right hand reaches belt tail and left elbow/wrist continue the visible corridor.
Visible standing torso and hips agree with ordinary support below the frame; no contradictory load or suspension.
Right fingertip-to-belt-tail contact, cloth overlap at chest clasp and cuff-to-upper-arm boundaries survive coherently.
Face, wrap closure, belt buckle/tail, cuff and both hands remain assessable from the selected frame.

integrated_data_qualification: No 49-new/61-enriched visual profile was exposed or selected; authorial keyword survival cannot count as proof of these integrated profiles.
